description: The multiplicative order of a modulo n: the least positive k with a^k = 1 mod n. The order of 2 mod 7 is 3, and the order of 3 mod 7 is 6. a must be coprime to n. n runs from 2 to 1000000. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/mult-order
